summary: Bind managed Cloud organization requests to a verified account and deliver request notifications through the host email service.
userImpact: Organization request emails reflect the verified requester and the current request status.
configuration: Set EG_CLOUD_ORGANIZATION_REVIEW_EMAIL and configure the default host email provider.
Use the exact HTTPS application origin and match the release controller credentials to the serving release.

changes: Adds an opt-in requester claim to the existing platform Cloud identity exchange.
Adds a private, release-bound endpoint for organization notifications.

security: The host rechecks the authenticated account and its current session before attesting requester identity.
The notification endpoint accepts fixed message types and checks the verified recipient.
knownLimitations: Requires a compatible Cloud control plane and a configured email sender.
rollback: Restore a compatible control plane and host together.
validation: Focused notification, authorization and restricted PostgreSQL requester-attestation checks passed.
